backdrop.note: Backdrop renders a fixed full-screen overlay and locks body scroll. Click the button to preview it, then click anywhere to dismiss.

spinner.description: Loading indicators that communicate an in-progress operation, from an indeterminate ring to a circular determinate indicator with percent.

determinate.note: The progress variant fills the arc as the value updates. Click play to watch it run from 0 to 100, with a label, percent, and description lines.

examples.note: Indicator-only by default — the visible label renders only when label or labelKey is explicit. The snippet shows the minimal template.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris UI package and import the spinner component and the loading-zone directive.

loading-zone.note: Wrap the region with solaris-loading-zone and render an overlay spinner inside it: the zone exposes aria-busy and becomes inert, so fields below stay disabled while loading. Click Save to try it.

props.note: Full props reference lives in the component documentation.

size-density.note: Adapted matrix: size drives the indicator geometry and the label/percent type scale, density adjusts the spacing. The snippet reflects the current selection.

spinner.title: Spinner
spinner.variants-desc: Ring and stacked are indeterminate; progress is the circular determinate indicator with percent. For linear bars, use progress.
